verdict.rationale: Grafana's docs describe a provisioning system that defines dashboards and data sources in version-controllable config files for GitOps, and an observability-as-code approach covering dashboards and other configurations through CI/CD pipelines. A CLI suited to CI/CD and a published OpenAPI spec support API-driven, repeatable deployment. missing for 10: explicit evidence that alert rules can be provisioned as code, Terraform provider documentation, JSON dashboard model detail, independent/hands-on corroboration of the as-code workflow.
